name: Behind Every Great One
author: m1s3ry
description:
Behind Every Great One is a game made by Deconstructeam for the Ludum Dare 42. The theme of the gamejam was "Running out of space". Gabriel is a really driven succesful artist. Victorine doesn't have any personal passions but supports Gabriel as a housewife. They love each other.
Credits to GrossleyMoo for helping with the port and developing UndertaleModTool. Without his help, a GMS 2 in a Vita would be a dream.
